title: request
description: Phone to hub, once welcomed: run one of a Bucket's commands whose Primitive is `request`, as its Descriptor declares it. The hub answers every request with exactly one `reply` carrying its `id`, and soon: the phone stops waiting after a few seconds. A request reads state and changes nothing, so it is safe to send again.

id.description: Chosen by the phone, unique among its requests on this connection; the `reply` carries it back.

bucket.description: The Descriptor `id` of the Bucket the command belongs to.
